readscout 0.1.7: local candidate, not published

Reliability fixes from the complete baseline audit: edit rollback on failed check launch, loading/busy llama.cpp protection,
file-scoped router dependencies, lexical filtering of environment references, honest partial log receipts and actual-byte input limits.
Malformed metrics no longer break the dashboard, and setup actions report failures instead of success.

Includes the deterministic inventories and skill references added after 0.1.6. `readscout info` prints the package path,
distribution version and content fingerprint without starting a model. Agent registration uses that package's environment;
skill status checks the references as well as the core.

This candidate was prepared locally. No new performance or token-savings claim is made, and no GitHub release was published.
Install the locally built wheel, run `readscout install-agent codex` and/or `readscout install-agent claude`, then reconnect
the clients so their already-running MCP processes and loaded skills use the new build.
